coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property leased or subleased for dwelling purposes. Dwelling units in one-family or two-family dwellings are excluded. Licensees of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission are excluded unless the licensee is the landlord.
coverage.other_conditions: Licensees of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission are exempt unless the licensee is the landlord.

result.notes: The existing coverage is supported by D066, so no values were changed. min_units=3 is derived from section 1.c(1), which excludes dwelling units in one-family or two-family dwellings; the statute does not state an owner-occupancy condition. The DCA Truth in Renting guide (D067) refers to 'reasonable rental application fees', but it predates P.L.2025, c.405 and does not affect coverage.
